comment: Targets of bin/build.sh. A target that does not exist yet is skipped, so a part lands before its workflow exists. block: the file carries the shared-block markers. table: the file carries the class-table markers. roles/aspects: the subset of lib/roles/*.md and lib/aspects/*.md stamped into that file (A23), by role name without the .md suffix. A key set to true whose marker pair is missing from an existing target fails the build, so a deleted marker is never a silent skip.

targets.comment: P6 rewrites this file with the class-table marker pair and flips table to true; the old base text carries no marker, and a true here would fail the build today
